issues.name: Fix Infisical PLANE_API_KEY secret mapping
issues.description: The Infisical env var PLANE_API_KEY currently exports an expired token (plane_api_89d0...). The working token is stored under a different secret name: 8-13-26GooseSyncBot (plane_api_7319...). Action: either rename the working secret to PLANE_API_KEY in Infisical, or update the sync recipe to read from 8-13-26GooseSyncBot. Without this, the scheduled Plane→Discord sync fails with 403 Forbidden.
issues.human_action: Log into Infisical (secrets.assistedly.ai) → rename or remap the active Plane API token to PLANE_API_KEY, then restart the Infisical Agent.

issues.name: Find YoURLS origin server and decide hosting strategy
issues.description: urls.assistedly.ai is active but its origin server is unknown. Not on any RackNerd IP. Cloudflare DNS lookup failed with auth error. This blocks password reset and Nextdoor UTM forwarding.
issues.human_action: Option A: Log into Cloudflare dashboard manually to view DNS A records for urls.assistedly.ai. Option B: Give Goose a Cloudflare API token with Zone:Read permission so it can query automatically. Decide whether YoURLS should stay separate or be consolidated onto known infrastructure.

issues.name: Set YoURLS admin password + document it securely
issues.description: Once the origin server is found (HUMAN-003), the YoURLS admin password needs to be reset. The new password must be stored in Infisical, not chat or local files.
issues.human_action: Choose a strong password → SSH to the YoURLS origin server → update config.php password hash → test login at /admin/ → store password in Infisical (not chat).

issues.description: The registration-cta-experiment-2026-08 multivariate test is live (variants: control / share_family / save_results). Analytics plumbing is wired PostHog→GA4→GTM. You need to review whether the test is yielding meaningful conversion lift and decide next steps.

issues.name: Decide on Nextdoor campaign depth

issues.name: Export LinkedIn DMs and import into Twenty CRM
issues.description: You want to avoid re-contacting people you've already DMed on LinkedIn (e.g., Alex Qi). Twenty CRM does not currently have these contacts. LinkedIn does not have a public API for DMs.

Option B: If LinkedIn Sales Navigator has an export, use it. Option C: Ask Goose to build a browser-automation script to scrape your LinkedIn DMs (requires login).

issues.name: Fix Google Sheets upload auth scope for AgeTech data
issues.description: Previous attempts to upload agetech_tier1_outreach.csv to Google Sheets failed with 403 Forbidden. The service account JSON likely lacks the Sheets API scope or is not added to the target spreadsheet.
issues.human_action: Go to Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service Accounts → find the account from GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON → enable Google Sheets API scope (https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets) → share the target Google Sheet with the service account email → retry upload via Goose.

issues.name: Design Twenty-Plane contact sync workflow
issues.description: User requested: 'Use Twenty as single source of truth for contacts. Add contacting highest priority person and why to Plane tasks for business development.' This needs a design decision before Goose builds it.
issues.human_action: Decide: (A) A daily Goose scheduled job reads Twenty → auto-creates Plane tasks, or (B) A manual trigger when you review Twenty. Decide what fields to sync (company, priority score, last activity, LinkedIn URL). Then ask Goose to build the recipe.
